questions: How long have you had this headache, and is it a sharp or throbbing pain?
Is the pain on one side or all over your head?
Are you experiencing any other symptoms, like fever, stiff neck, or vomiting?
recommendations: Stay well-hydrated, rest in a quiet, dark room, and avoid mobile/computer screens. Consider simple paracetamol if appropriate, but consult a doctor if the pain is severe.
source: AIIMS Patient Education Portal & Mayo Clinic
